full_judgment: 6. Defendant No. 16 has raised an objection that the suit was bad for misjoinder of parties. Schedule (B) properties being in possession of defendant Nos. 8 and 19, these defendants have got no connection with rest of the suit land. According to this defendant, the defendant No. 19 has got no possession and interest in schedule B land. The Will, if any, as alleged by the plaintiff was fraudulently and collusively created with a view to defraud the creditors. The clause restraining the legatees from transferring the properties was illegal and void. According to him, the bequest was absolute and complete by itself find the reservation clause is nothing but an attempt to protect the properties from their creditors. Girish had no right to make any provision regarding the properties inherited by Mohendra from his father. According to this defendant, the Will was never acted upon as will be evident from the partition deed executed by plaintiff's father and uncle sons and Mohendra after the probate was granted. This defendant claimed to be in possession of the properties in schedule (B) for over the statutory period of limitation by making construction upon the land and by excavating tank in a portion thereof.
